attribution: World Bank Open Data / World Development Indicators; underlying sources IMF, ILOSTAT and World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform
method: Most recent country observation explicitly displayed in the respective World Bank indicator page at snapshot date, rounded to 1 decimal. No imputations, time alignment or causal decomposition.
refresh: Dated snapshot; source changes are not reflected until reviewed and re-ingested.

indicators.name: Consumer price inflation
indicators.provider: International Monetary Fund (IMF), published by World Bank
indicators.explainer: Annual change in consumer prices, not overall household affordability.

indicators.name: Unemployment
indicators.provider: International Labour Organization (ILO), published by World Bank
indicators.explainer: Modelled unemployment within the labor force, not underemployment, poverty or wage adequacy.

indicators.name: Income inequality (Gini)
indicators.provider: World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform
indicators.explainer: Survey-based inequality; 0 is equal distribution, higher values indicate more inequality. Country years differ.
